articles.title: CFTC to join SEC in exploring crypto regulations without CLARITY bill
articles.snippet: The CFTC will hold a meeting for its Innovation Advisory Committee on Aug. 20 to address regulation related to crypto assets, artificial intelligence and prediction markets.

articles.title: Bitmine’s $257M annualized staking income ‘fills’ operational gaps, share buybacks: analysts
articles.snippet: Bitmine’s Ether staking revenue is an important financial buffer that fills financial gaps and provides recurring revenue streams beyond Ether’s price appreciation, analysts told Cointelegraph.

articles.title: China’s DeepSeek Upgrades V4 Pro: Claude Fable Is Only 5% Better at 4,500% the Price
articles.snippet: The April preview got benchmarked to death and landed 18 points behind Anthropic’s flagship. DeepSeek’s own numbers for the finished model tell a very different story.
